name: plan-campaign-goal-chain
description: Checks whether a stated goal is reachable on a given budget: fills an economics box with a source on every number, subtracts the baseline, works out the implied cost per customer against history or labelled base rates, and flags when the goal needs renegotiating. Use alone when you already have the goal (metric, number, date), budget, order value, margin and baseline; otherwise run plan-campaign.
